witness_description: No polynomial in the stated 1,458-polynomial space had exactly six roots in (-2,2) and one root in (2,14).
refutation_explanation: The exact bounded sweep found no counterexample. This is exhaustive only for the stated Eisenstein family and does not establish the claim for algebraic integers outside that family.
search_space: All 1,458 monic degree-7 polynomials x^7+a6*x^6+...+a1*x+a0 with a0 in {-2,2} and each of a1,...,a6 in {-2,0,2}; every polynomial is Eisenstein at 2. Exact Sturm sequences counted roots in (-2,2) and (2,14).
